caption: : Avg. rate at which the model attends most to each input segment: context, generated response, or other (e.g., system prompts) during generation.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the proportion of attention allocated to different input segments during model generation, specifically focusing on 'Context,' 'Generated Response,' 'Other,' and 'Standard' response types. The horizontal axis, labeled with segment types in alphabetical order, displays ‘Context,’ ‘Generated Response,’ ‘Other,’ and ‘Standard.’ The vertical axis represents the percentage of attention, ranging from 0% to 70%, with tick marks spaced at 10% intervals. The tallest bar, colored blue, represents ‘Our’ response, indicating approximately 60.6% attention allocated to the ‘Context’ segment. The second tallest bar, colored orange, represents ‘Yours’ response, exhibiting approximately 31.7% attention to the same segment. The shortest bar, colored green, represents ‘Standard’ response, with an approximate value of 23.6% allocated to the ‘Context’ segment. The bar labeled ‘Generated Response’ is colored orange and represents approximately 51.1% of attention to the ‘Generated Response’ segment. Finally, the bar labeled ‘Other’ is colored green and represents approximately 25.3% of attention to the ‘Other’ segment. All bars are presented without visual emphasis or sorting.
